findings.highlight: The fifteen meters between them
findings.evidenceJa: 十間は離れていた間合い
findings.governingReading: an initial distance of ten ken, approximately eighteen meters
findings.explanation: mirror moon silently converts the initial distance to fifteen meters while correctly following the explicit five-meter ruby on three ken.

findings.highlight: they are no different from throwing stones
findings.evidenceJa: 弾けば防げるモノならば礫と何ら変わらない
findings.governingReading: if they can be defended against by knocking them aside, they are no different from stones
findings.explanation: The comparison’s condition is removed, making the daggers categorically equivalent to stones rather than manageable because they can be deflected.

findings.highlight: Ha
findings.evidenceJa: チ
findings.governingReading: a tongue click, “Tch”
findings.explanation: Assassin’s irritation is changed into an indistinct vocalization.

findings.highlight: being displayed with the great difference in the strength of their Noble Phantasms and their levels as heroic spirits
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊としての格の違い、手にした宝具の性能差を見せつけられ
findings.governingReading: confronted with the difference in their rank as Heroic Spirits and the performance of the Noble Phantasms they wield
findings.explanation: The English reverses who is displaying what and produces a malformed account of the two separate disparities.

findings.highlight: I cannot be expected to match other Servants
findings.evidenceJa: まっとうな英霊に太刀打ちできる筈もない
findings.governingReading: he cannot hope to contend with a proper Heroic Spirit
findings.explanation: Assassin’s self-deprecating contrast with legitimate Heroic Spirits becomes an indiscriminate contrast with every other Servant.

findings.highlight: My master
findings.evidenceJa: 我が雇い主
findings.governingReading: my employer
findings.explanation: The English changes Assassin’s deliberately contractual employer relation into a Master bond.

findings.highlight: you can attack me with mere air pressure from where you are standing
findings.evidenceJa: その場からでも私を断てる
findings.governingReading: that wind pressure can cut me down even from where you stand
findings.explanation: The lethal cutting result that reverses Assassin’s range advantage is weakened to generic attack.

findings.highlight: close the distance himself to kill her first
findings.evidenceJa: 近づいてセイバーを捉えるのみ
findings.governingReading: approach and catch or engage Saber
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds an immediate killing outcome to Assassin’s stated need to close and seize her.

findings.highlight: a dragon’s fury
findings.evidenceJa: 竜の咆哮
findings.governingReading: a dragon’s roar
findings.explanation: The imminent wind blast’s sound image becomes an abstract emotion.

findings.highlight: It looks like a spider on a wall
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下に伏せたアサシンは、壁に這う蜘蛛に似ていた
findings.governingReading: Assassin lying prone in the corridor resembles a spider crawling on a wall
findings.explanation: The English loses Assassin’s posture and gives the simile an unclear pronoun anchor.

findings.highlight: He cannot withdraw even when he is talking
findings.evidenceJa: 会話に乗じて離脱しようとする事も許さない
findings.governingReading: she will not permit him even to attempt withdrawal under cover of conversation
findings.explanation: Assassin’s possible tactical use of his speech and Saber’s prevention of it are both blurred.

findings.highlight: Saber is staring at Assassin
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの眼は確実にアサシンを捉えている
findings.governingReading: Saber’s eyes have Assassin securely caught
findings.explanation: A combat lock guaranteeing interception is reduced to visual attention.

findings.highlight: Assassin crawls even lower
findings.evidenceJa: 更に深く身を屈める
findings.governingReading: Assassin crouches his body still lower
findings.explanation: The preparation for his charge is changed into locomotion.

findings.highlight: about to devour its prey
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下と髑髏の面を飲み込もうと
findings.governingReading: about to swallow the corridor and the skull mask
findings.explanation: The predicted breadth and concrete targets of the blast are replaced by a predator cliché.

findings.highlight: with a yell of delight
findings.evidenceJa: 歓喜の声と笑みを以って
findings.governingReading: with a delighted voice and smile
findings.explanation: The smile completing Assassin’s ecstatic acceptance of danger is omitted.

findings.highlight: The mud-like pollution invades on her silver
findings.evidenceJa: 泥のような汚濁が彼女の銀を侵していく
findings.governingReading: mudlike corruption encroaches upon her silver form
findings.explanation: The English is grammatically malformed at the moment the shadow begins corrupting Saber.

findings.highlight: This shadow swallows Servants
findings.evidenceJa: この影は自分を呑むものだ
findings.governingReading: this shadow is something that will swallow her, with “Servant” as the reading on “self”
findings.explanation: Saber’s immediate self-recognition and layered ruby are promoted into a categorical rule about all Servants.

findings.highlight: Only her feet have been engulfed
findings.evidenceJa: 影はまだ足元だけ
findings.governingReading: the shadow is still confined to the area at her feet
findings.explanation: A statement about the shadow’s current extent is turned into completed engulfment of both feet.

findings.highlight: watching Saber get swallowed
findings.evidenceJa: 対岸の火事の如く
findings.governingReading: watching as detachedly as a fire on the far bank
findings.explanation: Assassin’s coldly uninvolved manner is removed from the death-image setup.

findings.highlight: her feet
findings.evidenceJa: 両腿の感覚
findings.governingReading: the sensation in both thighs
findings.explanation: The bodily spread of numbness is mislocated, duplicating the toes and losing the thighs.

findings.highlight: something that does not exist in this world
findings.evidenceJa: 既にこの世にあってこの世にないモノ
findings.governingReading: something already present in this world yet no longer belonging to it
findings.explanation: The paradoxical intermediate state of Saber’s legs is reduced to simple nonexistence.

findings.highlight: lose consciousness
findings.evidenceJa: 正気を失おう
findings.governingReading: lose her sanity or reason
findings.explanation: Assassin’s claimed mental corruption effect is changed into passing out.

findings.highlight: His arm flaps, sending a shudder through her body
findings.evidenceJa: その戦慄が身に走るより早く、彼の腕は羽撃き
findings.governingReading: before that terror can run through her body, his arm lashes out
findings.explanation: The English makes the arm cause the shudder; the source says it moves before Saber can even experience the fear.

findings.highlight: A sound of cutting meat
findings.evidenceJa: 斬撃に断たれる音
findings.governingReading: the sound of something severed by a sword stroke
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents “meat,” prematurely steering the apparent result toward wounded flesh.

findings.highlight: Her blood drips onto the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 噴出される鮮血
findings.governingReading: fresh blood sprays out
findings.explanation: The speed and volume of the false-victory image are reduced, and the English prematurely assigns the blood to Saber.

findings.highlight: is severed at the elbow
findings.evidenceJa: 異形の呪腕は、失われていた
findings.governingReading: the grotesque cursed arm has been lost
findings.explanation: The reversal’s deliberately broad reveal is narrowed to an exact severing location not stated in this sentence.

findings.highlight: with that dying body of yours
findings.evidenceJa: 死ニ損ナイノ分際デ
findings.governingReading: you wretch who failed to die
findings.explanation: Assassin’s insult targets Saber as a survivor who should be dead; the English instead describes her as currently dying.

findings.highlight: Her upraised sword falls to the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 振り上げた剣が落ちる
findings.governingReading: the raised sword comes down
findings.explanation: The successful intercepting downstroke is made to sound as though Saber drops her weapon.

findings.highlight: She is becoming a part of this darkness
findings.evidenceJa: この闇は、既に彼女自身でもある
findings.governingReading: this darkness is already part of Saber herself or already also Saber
findings.explanation: An accomplished contamination that makes physical escape futile is weakened into an ongoing external absorption.
